text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho is almost here. Satono Diamond has broken the Satono family's jinx with a powerful victory in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stage shifts to the autumn Tenno Sho. Unfortunately, it's taking place in the worst weather on record, being held in the middle of a storm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black, however, isn't fazed. Unwavering, she charges into the race for the sake of the fans who braved the elements to see her run.
